entities.name: Nesrîn Abdullah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nesrin Abdullah is a commander and spokesperson for the militia group YPJ in Syria. She has been active in communicating the progress of the Kurdish and Syrian Democratic Forces operation to liberate Raqqa from ISIS. She was born in Al-Malikiyah of Al-Hasakah Governorate.

entities.name: Nesrîn Abdullah
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nesrin Abdullah is a commander and spokesperson for the militia group YPJ in Syria. She has been active in communicating the progress of the Kurdish and Syrian Democratic Forces operation to liberate Raqqa from ISIS. She was born in Al-Malikiyah of Al-Hasakah Governorate.
